c6036132d78900ce85a809e25e86317ce3a904d2.summary: KnowBe4's knowledgebase entry describes Pony Stealer, a password-stealing malware that can unlock passwords for over 110 applications and can turn infected PCs into a botnet. The entry says it is tied closely to the Reveton worm and was spread from late 2014 by phishing emails that impersonated the shipping company Maersk Line, using a PDF lure and phone numbers with Vietnamese area codes. Maersk warned customers about the fraud in January 2014.
